title: Flow Query revision 2 response
description: The public Flow Query revision 2 response. Inline JSON Schema is checked with the shared schema validator; validateFlowQueryResponse owns response-local semantic constraints. Source bytes, publication identity and producer meaning are checked by their canonical owners before projection.

relativePath.description: Normalized POSIX path relative to the selected Version directory; no absolute path, backslash, dot, empty or parent segment. The semantic validator enforces this boundary.

items.description: artifactId retains the existing content identity. artifactKey is a path-bound identity. confirmed-prefix is only valid for flow.activities; singleton requires memberId=null and collection requires memberId. Hash and size refer to exact captured bytes.
